content: In'kɔɔn a andweer
Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a un'kɔɔn amwɛy bàfü Yɛlusàlɛm ban'köŋ apà Yɛsu.
Ba ban'man naa alɔŋki ande amwɛy bàmudyà anà an'kɔɔ a ŋingyäy, iswaŋà naa ukɔɔn aywɛy ma.
Ntɔn Amfarisi, itàkal Ayudà banswà, bàfàdyà anki ukɔɔn aywɛy an'kɔɔ ubwaŋàbwaŋ, mulab nkääl a andweer.
Ba bàsàfà mukàlyaaŋ, ba bàfàdyà anki kusà mutàpöŋ. Ye anà nsyääl asin mbɔɔn yindweer bàfàlab ba: mpööŋ a an'kɔɔb, yà an'buuŋ anà yan'lɔŋà.
Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn ban'fuul Yɛsu naa: « Ntɔn nkye alɔŋki angye mpa bàfàlab ba in'kɔɔn a andweer, wɛɛ ba bàfàdyà anà an'kɔɔ a ŋingyäy? »
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Yɛsay kàtɛ ngɔɔm aŋàbwaŋ ntɔn bɛ baar a mpem yweel, ntɔn bàsön naa:

content.text: "Un'sɛŋ wà mɛ làkoo afan'sà udu a ndem mpɛl, wɛɛ mpem aba yukwɛl anà mɛ."

content: Bɛ nswɛɛŋ a Nzam làfàsà ukɔl, wɛɛ bɛ làfàndäär anà nsyääl a baar. »
Nde kàfàtɛn a ba naa: « Bɛ làfàtɔn ubwaŋàbwaŋ nswɛɛŋ a Nzam ntɔn mukaar nkääl abɛ!
Ntɔn Mɔsɛ kàtɛn naa: "Sà làkoo akà taaràŋà anà ngwa", sye naa: "Wɛy mbuur ato taarànde anà ngwän, ukyen ukwà."
Wɛɛ bɛ, bɛ làfàtɛn naa: mbuur usàtɛn a taarànde itàkal a ngwän naa: "Undiir alàwal ngye akà mɛ wà Kɔrban", ikaswaŋà naa "kab in'kyɛɛl",
bɛ làmun'pà mbwo naa nde ukɔɔn akyer akundiir mwɛy ntɔn taarànde itàkal ntɔn ngwän."
Lalan, bɛ làfàdwa Ndaa a Nzam ntɔn nkääl a andweer abɛ làfàlɔŋ bɛ. Bɛ làfàkyer sye indiir asin mbɔɔn byà ifà aki. »
Indiir ifàbuul mbuur ŋingyäy
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàfàbel un'sɛŋ a baar, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Lan'wem bɛ banswà, làyöb naa:
Akundiir mwɛy tɛy afàfà nsà awafàbilà uboo a mbuur afun'buul wàŋingyäy. Wɛɛ indiir ifàtoo u mbuur ifun'buul wàŋingyäy. »
[ Kya mbuur mwɛy usàkal anà an'tsü awem, wɛy nde uwem! ]
Umpal kàbilà Yɛsu u ndwà, ukwɛl a un'sɛŋ a baar, alɔŋki ande bun'fuulà ntɔn itim aki.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Nkye anà bɛ sye, abun bɛ un'yɛnà watɛy? Nkye bɛ làyöb anki naa undiir mwɛy tɛy afafà nsà anà afàbilà uboo a mbuur ukwe anki mukun'buul wàŋingyäy,
ntɔn wa ufàbilà anki u mpem ande, wɛɛ kan'bäl ande, ungö wa akyà u nkuràndwà? » Abun nde kàkyäänà naa isaa byanswà byàŋàpɔŋà.
Nde waa kàtɛn naa: « Ndaa ifafà uboo a mbuur, ya ifun'buul wàŋingyäy.
Ntɔn an'kyän an'be ifàtoo fà boo, fà mpem a baar: ipasàsɛ, küb, ndwääl a baar,
intswem, ngyal a in'naaŋ, an'kyän an'be, loor, mɔ̈ɔ̈ a isak isak, intwɛn, mbɛɛy, nsɛɛn a an'pɛy, unsil.
Indiir ibe abi byanswà byàfàtoo uboo, waa byàfàbuul mbuur wàŋingyäy. »
Làkwikilà a un'kaar ungyey
Yɛsu kàlwomà nde apan, nde kàkyen itiir a Tir. Nde kàbilà u ndwà mwɛy, nde kàkwen anki naa akà mbuur mwɛy uyɔ̈b. Wɛɛ yàkwe anki naa nde ukäl aŋàyee.
Yàmɛnà naa un'kaar mwɛy, mwan ande wun'kaar kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe. Pa kàwem nde làsaŋ a Yɛsu, laa kàyi nde, waa kàbü kà in'kɔl ande.
Un'kaar awà kàkäl ungɛlɛki, un'nsi Fɛnisi u Siri. Nde kàlɔ̈ɔ̈mà akà Yɛsu naa nde uböŋ unsɔŋà unsà mwan ande wun'kaar.
Yɛsu kàtɛɛnà a nde naa: « Wɛy baan bàtàyuur, kàyubwaŋ anki muwal isaa a baan ntɔn mutɔɔm bya akà bimbwà. »
Nde wà kun'fuur naa: « Ndandaa, Mwol, itàkal bimbwà, ungyɛl a mɛsà, byàfàdyà mfür a isaa a baan. »
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ntɔn ndaa ayi, kyen: unsɔŋà kan'too u mwan angye wun'kaar. »
Nde kàfura ndwà ande, waa kàmɛn mwan ande wàŋàsilà udu a itäb: unsɔŋà akyàtoo amu nde.
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr nkiin ikwan'tsü
Yɛsu kàlwomà nde itiir a Tir, nde kàfurà ntsü a ɛwà a Ngalilɛ u mbwo a Sidɔn, waa kàlyaŋ itiir a Dɛkapɔl.
Baar bun'twääl nkiin mwɛy kàyäämà a mpay, ba bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa nde kun'si kɔɔ.
Apan, Yɛsu kun'syen ukɔl, ukwel a un'sɛŋ a baar, kun'biil mpin kan'tsü, kàtsül an'te, waa kun'bä u làlem.
Ungö nde kàsɛn mii u du, kànyääm ikye, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Efàfàta! » Ikaswaŋà naa: « Dubà! »
Kà imbürà, an'tsü ande waa màdubà, làlem ande waa làtsuŋà, waa kàyäämà ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Yɛsu kaswɛŋ naa ba bàkɔɔn asam akà mbuur mwɛy. Wɛɛ kàsin aswaŋà nde, ba bàsin apayà làsaŋ.
Ba bàkäl mubem mbɔɔn, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Indiir byanswà nde kan'kyer ubwaŋ! Nde wàmukyer naa ikwan'tsü bàwem, nkiin bàsi ndaa! »
